title: Lifting planar substitution along multilinear restriction equivalences
statement:
Use the universes, quasicategories, coherent functors and colimits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], and the unital planar operation systems of [lem-coef-monoidal-block-projection-coherence]. Fix a universe of small colimit shapes and a larger universe containing all the following categories. Let $A$ be an infinity category with a unital planar operation system $(m_r)_{r\geq0}$, let $B$ admit all small colimits, and let $f:A\to B$ be a coherent functor. Write $\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathrm{sep}}(B^r,B)$ for the full functor category on functors preserving small colimits separately in all $r$ variables. Assume for every finite $r\geq0$ that restriction induces an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathrm{sep}}(B^r,B)\xrightarrow{(f^r)^*}\operatorname{Fun}(A^r,B).$$
For $r=0$ both categories are $B$ and restriction is the identity. Suppose separately cocontinuous functors $M_r:B^r\to B$ have been chosen, together with coherent natural equivalences $\theta_r:M_rf^r\simeq fm_r$, with $M_0=f(m_0)$ and $M_1=\mathrm{id}_B$, using the given unary identity equivalence. There exist unital planar substitution equivalences and all their tree-indexed compatibility simplices on the $M_r$ for which the $\theta_r$ constitute a morphism of unital planar operation systems. For each finite planar rooted tree with $r$ ordered external inputs, these coherences are transformations between its composite functors $B^r\to B$; nullary vertices are allowed and each external input occurs exactly once. The space of these coherent lifts with the specified restriction and vertex comparisons is contractible. This assertion is made on the reduced external input lists, before pullback along any projections adding unused inputs.
